title: MapGIS 6.7 钻孔数据、柱状图与轨迹投影剖面
execution: Use the public stdio MCP tools below. Save new branches, then use original BAS60 to save/freshly reopen the editable vectors and native MPJ before output. No desktop input.
validation_scope: Two labelled analytical holes, one quarter-circle minimum-curvature path and one vertical, explicit unlogged interval, native WT/WL/WP, source/result XLSX, MPJ/EPS/PDF/TIFF. 29 actual MCP calls plus21 recovery calls after parent exits102/104/103. This is the documented2D subset, not complete proprietary geology modules or native3D files.
inputs: 孔口表 hole_id/easting/northing/elevation；测斜表 hole_id/md/inclination/azimuth；分层表 hole_id/top/base/unit 及可选 description
各表首行字段名和工作表名显式映射；孔号原样字符串；测量为原始数值，不读取未核验公式缓存
明确平面/垂直单位为米、格网北、向下测斜倾角、高程基准；MD从0开始递增，不外推
柱状图竖向比例、图上柱宽与间距；剖面起终点、最大离面距离、水平/竖向比例和采样步长
地层到工程系统库样式的明确映射；不得按颜色推断地质类别

steps.action: Inspect table names/headers and bind source SHA. Map each of the three tables explicitly. Set sort_by_depth=true only when sorting is intended; retain original row lineage.
checks: 测斜站顺序及角度约定
分层不重叠、不越界；缺失区间保持未编录

steps.action: Compute model positions with pinned wellpathpy minimum curvature and SciPy spherical direction interpolation. Query MDs within the supplied range. Project a supplied true dip only when a real attitude is given.
checks: 独立解析或已知轨迹检查点
倾向不同于走向，视倾角符号随剖面方向

steps.action: Pass the hash-bound workbook binding so it is re-read and guarded through publication. mode=columns plots MD down; mode=section projects the actual sampled trace to the declared straight vertical plane, elevation up. Use explicit native region styles and separate labels. Output is WP plus sibling WL/WT/XLSX/JSON.
checks: 全部原生点线区保存和新进程回读
柱宽为图上宽度，XYZ保留在表
注明比例、纵向夸大和模型轨迹，无自动孔间连层

steps.action: Use WP, WL and WT in that drawing order and a checked library binding. Reopen the three-layer MPJ, set the native drawing-mm page view explicitly, then export EPS/PDF/TIFF. View final output and check the actual chart relationships.
checks: 轴线刻度可见，岩性花纹可分辨，标注不遮挡关键内容
原生范围与纸张比例一致
EPS像素对照；密集花纹必要时300dpi原条件复核

steps.action: After a lost reply first inspect the same request ID. Recover completed native saves and frozen files; resume only stages not previously issued. Modified input workbook or chart specification is rejected.
checks: 恢复后点线区与未编录表再次回读
